meta.curves: mid-run mean (36-44 Myr); the force areas are components A, T and S, not a range -- only the velocity panel's band is the full run, t >= 8 Myr
meta.areas: A measured to z_c; T = |dP| z_c; S tilt-removed from z_c to 200 km; A+T+S is the static limit
meta.zc: z_c is a single declared depth standing in for a sigma_zz maximum that moves 42-126 km through the runs; justified in fig_ridge_cumulative
meta.density_route: a check curve, not a fourth value; it carries no elevation mass
